many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

demo2_output=[[7,7,0,9,0],[8,0,0,9,0],[2,2,2,9,5]]
program = '''def transform(grid):
    bars = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
            if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0, 9)]
    heights = []
    for r in bars:
        color = grid[r][0]
        height = 0
        for rr in range(r + 1, len(grid)):
            if grid[rr][0] == 9:
                break
            if any(x == color for x in grid[rr]):
                height += 1
        heights.append(height)
    tallest = max(heights)
    return [[grid[r][0]] * ((h + 1) // 2)
            + [0] * (3 - (h + 1) // 2)
            + [9, 5 if h == tallest else 0]
            for r, h in zip(bars, heights)]
'''
